method: Installed Chrome headless; no software GPU flags. Hardware WebGPU and WebGL are asserted separately. Independent seeded captures use deterministic 60 Hz stepping.
limitations: Portrait is viewport/touch emulation on this PC. No physical-phone, thermal, completed-GPU-frame timing or long-duration performance claim.
